description: This file defines the AWS Metering service integration for Mattermost, including data structures, service initialization, and usage reporting functions.

classes.name: AwsMeter
classes.description: Main struct for AWS metering, holds store, service, and config references.

classes.name: AWSMeterService
classes.description: Service configuration including dry run flag, product code, and metering client.

classes.name: AWSMeterReport
classes.description: Data structure representing a metering report entry with JSON serialization.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Initializes a new AwsMeter instance with AWS metering service.

methods.name: GetUserCategoryUsage
methods.description: Generates usage reports for specified dimensions within a time range.

methods.name: ReportUserCategoryUsage
methods.description: Sends usage reports to AWS metering service.
